criteria.rule: Canonical fresh-document structural/source-span/whole-Latin-word checks, exact frozen cues/profile, current versions and selected model.
All four input cues occur in selected units.

A selected source cue alone does not exercise a teaching rule. Required forms must be cited and taught; otherwise targetCoverage is not_exercised and the case is not accepted. No content reruns to obtain missing targets.

Distinguish a form in this instance from an exclusive rule. Do not universalize the current tense/form; essential alternatives remain compatible with generalizations. Recognize the complete compound predicate rather than classifying it only by the auxiliary. Simpler level does not justify a false universal. An explicitly local explanation is acceptable; a comprehensive grammar lecture is not required.

Check all source translations, contexts/titles, chunks, explanations, patterns, examples and available written readings for source roles, actors/person/number, timing, grammar, exact citations and coherent situations. Pending findings are not automatically accepted.

acceptance: Generated, structural/source/identity/source coverage and required target coverage passed, with no blocking or pending editorial findings. Nonblocking warnings remain explicit.
stoppingRule: One whole generation per case. Preserve all client requests/responses and existing internal structural repairs. No fallback, alternative result selection, rubric changes, prompt/runtime changes or content reruns during this round. A pre-model credential-lock failure can be retried only with zero model calls and retained separate evidence.

references.supports: Perfect subjunctive can refer to future completion, including a future main clause with cuando hayan comenzado. Supports a counterexample to present-only claims, not automatic severity or translation judgments.

limits: Same unblinded Codex reviewer and reviewer-authored contrast, not independent or a held-out benchmark.
One output per case; no stability/causality/overall accuracy estimate and no pooling older acceptances.
Older Spanish sender-reference, Japanese timing and Chinese reported-role disputes remain independently pending; new outputs do not rewrite those decisions.
Installed Host/Chrome/real-video acceptance follows separately only if this focused round passes; text-only results do not establish audio or learning outcomes.
